sources.title: DSSAT User's Guide, Volume 3, WeatherMan Reference Guide, Appendix B, pp. 197-199
sources.version_caveat: The guide labels itself DSSAT v3 and is not a 4.8.0.024 or 4.8.5 schema conformance test.

sample_variation: CNLC.CLI has only the climate/descriptive and GSST/GSDU portion in the inspected 9-line file; CNSY.CLI has all five sections. This is not enough to determine the active WGEN parser's minimum required blocks.

requiredness_summary.WGEN mode: The legacy official guide says WGEN parameters must be present in the climate file to use WGEN. Exact required columns and parser behavior for the active 4.8.x runtime remain untested.
requiredness_summary.SIMMETEO: The legacy guide identifies monthly averages as SIMMETEO inputs; not a substitute for WGEN parameters.
requiredness_summary.range checks and flagged counts: The legacy guide describes range checks as WeatherMan import QC metadata and flagged counts as archive statistics; active-runtime parser requiredness is unconfirmed.
